title: RelativeTensorPullbackComplexComparison
statement: Let f:X -> S be a scheme morphism. Let G:Mod(O_S) -> Mod(O_X) be an additive functor whose objects and maps are the canonical tensor pullback. For arbitrary unbounded complexes A over O_X and L over O_S, the underlying abelian-sheaf complex of Tot(A tensor_O_X G(L)) is isomorphic to the underlying abelian-sheaf complex of Tot(A restricted to f-inverse O_S tensor termwise inverse-image L). No K-flatness or derived category is assumed.

source.place: Cohomology Lemma 20.27.4, Tag 08DE; Tag 08EV, second displayed equality

proof.text: Use the balanced section tensor isomorphism a tensor (b tensor l) maps to (b*a) tensor l, with inverse a tensor l maps to a tensor (1 tensor l). The balancing relations give inverse maps; naturality in restrictions sheafifies these maps to the tensor sheaves.

Naturality in each factor commutes with each differential. Both total differentials use sign (-1)^p on the second differential. Forgetting scalars preserves coproducts, so coproduct the summand isomorphisms over p+q=n to get inverse chain maps in every degree.
